items.source: Abstract transactional extension of AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests which adds convenience functionality for JDBC access.
items.translation: 抽象 `transactional` 扩展的 AbstractTestNGSpringContextTests，它为 JDBC 访问添加了便利功能。

items.source: Abstract base test class which integrates the Spring TestContext Framework with explicit ApplicationContext testing support in a TestNG environment.
items.translation: 抽象基测试类，它将 Spring TestContext Framework 与显式的 ApplicationContext 测试支持集成在 TestNG 环境中。

items.source: Support classes for integrating the Spring TestContext Framework with TestNG.
items.translation: 支持将Spring TestContext Framework与TestNG集成的辅助类。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。
